are-accessory-essential-genes-mobile-ele.reason: Curing the element in host strains and measuring growth decides it; BERDL neighbourhood analysis only narrows which genes to test.

are-co-occurring-resistance-island-genes.reason: Whether island genes sit physically adjacent and how widely they recur across lineages decides it, with positions still needing retrieval from the pangenome collection.

are-conserved-genes-that-help-when-delet.reason: Deciding it needs new gene fitness measurements in sand, soil and competition cultures, which only new library experiments can provide.

are-gapfilled-reactions-without-ec-numbe.reason: Catalysis by a candidate enzyme family is only shown by in vitro activity, so the hypothesis needs a lab assay after a lakehouse analysis narrows the candidates.

are-genes-essential-in-some-bacteria-but.reason: Deciding needs a paralog deletion experiment in a dispensable organism, with candidates first chosen from existing Fitness Browser and pangenome comparisons.

are-latent-biosynthetic-and-catabolic-pa.reason: Decided by whether latent pathways are absent from more same-species genomes than active ones, most for carbon versus amino acid pathways, plus whether latent-rich species vary more.

are-metal-specific-genes-kept-patchily-i.reason: Decided by whether metal-specific gene presence across same-species genomes tracks contaminated isolation habitats, using KBase Data Lakehouse gene, pangenome and habitat records.

are-nitrogen-fixation-and-acc-deaminase-.reason: Gains and losses on plant-associated branches of genus trees in BERDL pangenomes decide it; the trees must be built from existing data.

are-open-pangenomes-a-general-permissive.reason: Existing pangenome tables in the Pangenome Collection can decide it, once a non-mobile accessory category and the species tree are joined.

are-persistently-unannotated-genes-young.reason: Composition, presence and remote-relative searches over KBase Data Lakehouse pangenome and UniRef data decide it, for linked dark genes only; 17,479 unlinked genes stay unassessed.

are-singleton-genes-neutral-in-the-lab-b.reason: Only transposon fitness measurements under phage challenge can decide it; BERDL predictions of phage-related singletons come first to choose which genes to test.

can-fitness-module-transfer-correctly-pr.reason: An existing-data benchmark of hidden essential-gene functions comes first, then depletion experiments on top predictions are needed to decide the hypothesis.

could-soil-drying-not-heat-explain-tenta.reason: Only a moisture-only soil-core experiment, holding temperature fixed, can show whether the transcript rise follows moisture rather than heat; existing records can narrow it first.

do-alkaline-soils-hold-lineages-that-hav.reason: Deciding it needs soil taxa from NMDC samples matched to pangenome genomes, then unmatched taxa compared across pH ranges at equal sample counts per region.

do-catalase-and-urease-status-predict-me.reason: Growth tests of copper, nickel, zinc and cadmium on paired strains decide it; the Fitness Browser checks only overlapping organisms, so new strain measurements are needed.

do-commensal-mixes-suppress-pseudomonas-.reason: Only new growth experiments can decide it, measuring the mix and its members against PA14 and a second strain with substrates added back.

do-conserved-proteins-with-almost-no-rel.reason: Deciding it needs core gene clusters joined to Fitness Browser phenotypes, plus gene lengths, which the note does not confirm are available.

do-contamination-site-isolates-really-to.reason: Decided by measuring copper, zinc, cadmium and nickel tolerance in culture-collection strains from each source class; genome scores cannot show tolerance.

do-copper-rich-soils-select-against-ener.reason: Decided by whether existing lakehouse soil and Fitness Browser fitness data show copper-specific energy-gene patterns against other metals.

do-deep-clay-bacillota-b-reduce-iron-thr.reason: Whether flavin pathways drive iron reduction is decided by a cultured clay isolate's Fe(III) reduction with and without pathway knockout; genome searches can only narrow candidates.

do-ecotype-defining-accessory-genes-move.reason: Comparing gene trees with core-genome trees across categories decides it, and needs BERDL sequences the note does not confirm.

do-efflux-genes-matter-under-antibiotics.reason: Knockout fitness of resistance genes across existing Fitness Browser experiments decides it, needing drug-spectrum labels from annotations.

do-genes-bridging-regulation-and-metabol.reason: Existing BERDL pangenome, domain and exchange data can decide whether architecture count explains the bridging excess; the census needs more compute.

do-glycosyltransferase-genes-near-secret.reason: Whether the metal-resistance genes sit on the same element as the glycosyltransferase is decided by checking contigs in pangenome genomes, which needs element and mobile-element calls not yet produced.

do-host-associated-bacteria-respond-less.reason: Deciding it needs host-proximal labels from isolation-source text in the pangenome metadata, then comparing free-living and host-associated species under both environment measures.

do-human-associated-bacteria-carry-proph.reason: Within-genus anti-defense counts against defense counts, beyond genome size, and their human-associated versus freshwater contrast decide it, using Pangenome Collection genomes.

do-iron-scavenging-gene-clusters-give-es.reason: Growth advantage under iron limitation needs new pairwise competition assays; scoring genome carriage in the KBase Data Lakehouse narrows which strain pairs to test.

do-larger-deep-clay-bacillota-b-genomes-.reason: Growing a cultured Desulfosporosinus isolate with and without single amino acids decides whether it needs supplied amino acids; BERDL analysis first narrows which amino acids to test.

do-metal-resistance-hotspots-in-environm.reason: Deciding it needs measured metal concentrations at matched sites, which are not confirmed in BERDL and must be gathered from other studies.

do-newly-acquired-resistance-genes-pay-a.reason: Fitness Browser knockout data and genome sequences in BERDL can test whether host-like composition predicts lower resistance-gene cost.

do-phyla-without-phb-carry-other-carbon-.reason: Scoring glycogen, polyphosphate and lipid storage genes across BERDL pangenome species decides it, needing only existing annotations and genome sizes.

do-rare-earth-rich-acid-sites-use-lantha.reason: Whether candidates bind lanthanides more strongly than calcium needs a lab binding measurement; BERDL genomes can first pick the candidates to test.

do-rare-earth-rich-sites-select-lanthani.reason: Only lab cultures with added lanthanum, measuring xoxF expression and uptake, can decide the hypothesis; BERDL metagenomes come first to narrow it.

do-the-crohn-s-linked-pathobionts-themse.reason: Only cultured pathobionts, singly and in a pooled community with and without them, profiled by metabolomics can show which axis metabolites they make.

do-the-metabolic-ecotypes-within-a-bacte.reason: Ecotype-versus-subclade matching to isolation environment, using BERDL pathway and metadata, decides it, including whether variable pathways are nutrient routes tied to each habitat's nutrient sources.

do-trace-aromatics-in-growth-media-expla.reason: Only new growth assays of ADP1 deletion mutants in scrubbed media, with and without trace aromatics, can decide it.

do-truly-dark-genes-act-in-nutrient-and-.reason: Existing Fitness Browser phenotype and co-fitness data across deep-panel organisms can decide it; new iron, alternative-nitrogen and mixed-carbon screens would only confirm.

do-truncated-proteins-explain-genes-leth.reason: Only new growth tests of truncated ADP1 alleles in rich medium can show whether partial proteins survive; insertion mapping narrows which genes to truncate.

do-unannotated-genes-in-field-relevant-c.reason: Only growing the mutants in groundwater-like and standard lab medium decides whether defects are specific to groundwater conditions; the lakehouse lacks that chemistry.

do-water-table-layers-not-lateral-distan.reason: Depth versus lateral position needs existing community data; whether chemistry tracks community turnover needs registered geochemistry measurements not yet loaded.

does-a-burst-of-nadh-from-quinate-breakd.reason: Only new ADP1 deletion and overexpression strains, grown on quinate at lowered uptake, glucose and acetate, can decide all three predictions.

does-acinetobacter-adp1-handle-urea-thro.reason: Only deleting urea-specific genes and testing growth on urea as carbon versus nitrogen decides it; prior growth-data and pangenome analysis must pick genes.

does-adp1-stay-a-continuous-gradient-whe.reason: Only new growth measurements on the ADP1 deletion collection and wild-type chemical exposures can decide whether the structure stays continuous; existing data serve only as reference.

does-amino-acid-biosynthesis-shape-how-m.reason: Deciding the hypothesis needs new fitness runs with and without histidine and tryptophan under antibiotic; existing Fitness Browser data lack that supplementation contrast.

does-carrying-both-aromatic-and-non-arom.reason: Co-carriage can be checked in existing genome calls, but whether generalists grow slower than same-genus specialists and use mixtures in sequence needs new growth assays.

does-carrying-many-metal-resistance-type.reason: Gain ordering of metal types and habitat categories on the existing Pangenome tree decides the hypothesis, using isolation-source metadata already held.

does-carrying-the-cyanide-operon-impair-.reason: Only a deletion experiment in a diazotroph can show whether losing the cyanide operon raises nitrogenase activity and nitrogen-free growth; a genome analysis first picks the strain.

does-desulfovibrio-vulgaris-make-serine-.reason: Growth without added serine and labelled serine in defined medium decide the hypothesis, and only a new lab experiment can supply them.

does-essential-metal-cofactor-handling-n.reason: Whether uptake and cofactor genes are more often core than detoxification genes, using existing Fitness Browser and Pangenome data.

does-gene-length-predict-core-status-bec.reason: Whether length still predicts core status within matched gene ages and dense insertion coverage, using Fitness Browser, pangenome and UniRef data already in the lakehouse.

does-lipid-a-loss-in-caulobacter-need-bo.reason: Deciding it requires constructing new Caulobacter strains with lpxC and respiratory gene deletions and measuring viability and redox balance.

does-resistance-gene-turnover-replace-ge.reason: Whether resistance gene composition turns over while counts stay flat is decided by dated genomes, whose collection dates must be sourced from public records.

does-soil-carbon-pathway-completeness-ri.reason: Deciding it needs paired taxonomy and metabolomics from at least two soil studies, which BERDL may already hold.

does-the-butyrate-producer-anaerostipes-.reason: Only anaerobic co-culture and defined-community add/remove assays measuring lactate, butyrate and growth can decide whether pathobionts change Anaerostipes caccae lactate use or butyrate output.

does-the-same-gut-species-become-crohn-s.reason: Only a gnotobiotic mouse experiment can decide whether candidate expansion depends on community state, after a BERDL cohort analysis narrows the candidates.

does-warming-deplete-labile-carbon-in-mi.reason: Respiration after labile substrate addition needs new incubations of heated and control soil, and existing metabolite lists cannot measure it.

does-zinc-excess-kill-bacteria-by-damagi.reason: Only a new iron-rescue experiment under zinc can decide whether iron selectively rescues iron-sulfur gene defects; existing overlap data narrow the genes first.

is-a-protein-s-abundance-a-bet-on-how-mu.reason: Deciding it needs ADP1 proteins measured under the eight carbon sources, because existing proteomes mix seven strains and cannot isolate ADP1.

is-a-resistance-gene-s-conservation-set-.reason: Core versus accessory resistance genes within each mechanism class, judged by non-antibiotic stress fitness and how closely their fitness tracks non-resistance genes, decides it.

is-defense-gene-enrichment-under-contami.reason: Testing whether defense genes track contamination within genera needs isolate genomes linked to well location and geochemistry in BERDL, and it is not established that enough exist.

is-environmental-adaptation-concentrated.reason: Deciding this needs habitat labels and per-category gene-cluster content for the same Pangenome species, already held in BERDL and analysed by category.

is-fungal-variability-in-lignin-enrichme.reason: Only new enrichment cultures at several inoculum sizes, with and without an early colonist, can show whether the variation comes from sampling or priority effects.

is-one-denitrifier-s-costly-dispensable-.reason: Decided by new pooled mutant competition under aerobic and anaerobic nitrate growth, since existing RCH2 oxygen data are confounded with metal salt.

is-polyhydroxybutyrate-storage-gained-re.reason: Within-genus habitat variability, genome size, accessory phaC occurrence, and phaC gene-tree versus species-tree incongruence, all in existing KBase Data Lakehouse pangenome records, decide it.

is-recent-gain-of-defense-systems-fast-t.reason: Deciding it needs only gene presence across descendant genomes on the species tree, already held in the lakehouse, plus existing gain-depth estimates.

is-soil-habitat-associated-with-xoxf-gai.reason: Within-genus habitat comparisons and gain/loss mapping on genome trees use existing pangenome and habitat data in the lakehouse, though habitat coverage per genome is uncertain.

is-the-acetate-specific-defect-of-aciad3.reason: Deciding it needs new growth, redox and rescue measurements on ADP1 deletion strains, since BERDL lacks these phenotypes.

is-the-acid-and-warmth-niche-split-betwe.reason: Growth in monoculture and co-culture across a pH series must be measured in the lab; BERDL sample data cannot separate competition from tolerance.

is-the-groundwater-versus-sediment-split.reason: Only simultaneous sampling of groundwater and sediment from the same wells can show whether the partition persists or was caused by timing.

is-the-overlap-between-metal-and-salt-st.reason: Only new transposon-library fitness assays with matched sorbitol, KCl and choline chloride controls can separate osmotic from ionic causes.

is-the-resistance-gene-excess-in-clinica.reason: Deciding it needs public antibiotic-resistance ontology terms to classify clusters, alongside existing pangenome and environment data from BERDL.

is-tryptophan-in-pseudomonas-fluorescens.reason: Nitrogen-source growth in these strains decides the hypothesis and needs new lab growth assays; BERDL analysis narrows which genes and strains to test.

is-uranium-itself-or-acidity-and-nitrate.reason: Separating uranium from acidity and nitrate needs controlled microcosms, because field samples confound these causes and cannot isolate uranium.

is-xoxf-mostly-a-methanol-enzyme-or-does.reason: Deciding whether XoxF serves other alcohols needs enzyme assays, but a BERDL genome analysis of methylotrophy genes must first narrow which carriers to test.

was-lanmodulin-spread-by-horizontal-tran.reason: Gene-tree versus species-tree conflict, flanking mobile-element genes and base composition versus host decide transfer, using existing pangenome genomes and new analysis.

were-sugar-pathways-lost-repeatedly-with.reason: Growth of CF and environmental isolates on sorbitol, mannitol and gluconate decides it, after a pangenome analysis of lung-branch pathway losses.

what-do-lanmodulin-carrying-bacteria-wit.reason: Deciding it needs growth and metal-uptake tests in a xoxF-free strain; BERDL screening first narrows which strain to use.

why-is-the-model-sulfate-reducer-desulfo.reason: Deciding it needs a new dsrAB assay on anaerobic-well sediment and groundwater, after existing ENIGMA CORAL profile comparison narrows the targets.
